summary_zh: 独立开发者自建 Codex Pro 20x 号池中转站，反映开发者对官方 API 配额和成本的不满，以及共享/代理基础设施的兴起。
summary_en: A developer-built relay station pooling Codex Pro 20x accounts, highlighting demand for cheaper, shared access to premium AI coding tools.

canonical_zh: MCP 服务器发现与注册表
summary_zh: 随着 MCP 生态爆发，开发者开始构建 MCP 服务器目录/注册表，类似 npm 之于 Node.js，成为新的基础设施机会。
summary_en: With the MCP ecosystem exploding, developers are building directories/registries for MCP servers, akin to npm for Node.js, creating new infrastructure opportunities.

canonical_zh: AI 编程 Agent 订阅套利
summary_zh: 围绕 Codex Pro 等订阅服务的转售和共享形成灰色市场，反映 AI 工具定价与用户实际需求之间的错位。
summary_en: A gray market is forming around reselling/sharing subscriptions like Codex Pro, reflecting a mismatch between AI tool pricing and actual user needs.

canonical_zh: 自托管 AI 编程网关
summary_zh: 开发者自建网关来代理和管理多个 AI 编程服务，以获得更好的性价比和控制力，预示着一波自托管 AI 基础设施工具的出现。
summary_en: Developers are self-hosting gateways to proxy and manage multiple AI coding services for better cost-performance and control, hinting at a wave of self-hosted AI infrastructure tools.
